sections.heading: 1. Data Collection & Processing
sections.text: When you submit a project request through our contact form, we collect your name, email address, selected service, and project requirements. To ensure website security and prevent automated spam, our system temporary processes your IP address. This data is collected and processed securely using Google Cloud Infrastructure (Google Apps Script) for the sole purpose of handling your order and protecting our services.

sections.heading: 2. Order Notifications & Automation
sections.text: Upon submitting the form, our automated system triggers order tracking notifications. You will receive an automated email titled 'We received your inquiry! - NovaOrders' confirming your submission, while our team at NovaOrders receives a notification titled '🚀 New Project Inquiry' to begin processing your request.

sections.heading: 3. Data Use & Security
sections.text: Your personal data and project details are used exclusively by NovaOrders to communicate with you and deliver the requested services. We do not share, sell, or disclose your information to any third parties.

sections.heading: 4. No Tracking Cookies
sections.text: Our website does not use any tracking cookies, marketing pixels, or analytics software. Your browsing experience and data remain completely private and confidential.

sections.heading: 5. Contact Information
sections.text: If you have any questions regarding your data privacy or wish to request the deletion of your messages, please contact us directly at lostangelscoding@gmail.com.

sections.heading: 1. Order Execution, Timeline & Impediments
sections.text: All services provided by NovaOrders are custom-built. Due to security protocols and the development process, standard delivery takes between 6 to 13 business days from the moment the project details are finalized. In the event that a project cannot be completed due to unforeseen technical complications or inability to fulfill the requests, NovaOrders will immediately notify the client. In such cases, the client retains the right to decide on the next course of action, including modifying the project requirements or canceling the order.

sections.heading: 2. Fair Use & Anti-Spam Policy
sections.text: To ensure stable performance and availability of our services for all potential clients, our contact form is protected by automated rate-limiting solutions. Abuse of the system, infrastructure flood attempts, or submitting rapid automated requests may result in a temporary or permanent block of the user's IP address and email.

sections.heading: 3. Revision Policy
sections.text: We strive for perfection. Revisions and corrections are completely free of charge if the delivered work does not meet the initial requirements and specifications provided by the client in the order form.

sections.heading: 4. Payment & File Delivery
sections.text: Our workflow operates on a 'Payment Upon Approval' basis. The client is required to settle the payment only after reviewing and accepting the final project preview. Final project files will be securely sent to the client immediately after the payment is successfully processed.

sections.heading: 5. Intellectual Property & Copyrights
sections.text: Copyright ownership is determined entirely by the client. Upon receiving full payment, all agreed intellectual property rights regarding the delivered project and source code are handled according to the client's preferences and final specifications.

sections.heading: 6. Limitation of Liability
sections.text: Services provided by NovaOrders are delivered 'as is'. NovaOrders shall not be held liable for any damages, data loss, or issues arising from the external deployment or misuse of the final files by the client.
